# Clear Claude

> Clear Claude makes Claude Code easier to understand without making it less capable. It is a Claude Code plugin marketplace (`clear-claude`, at github.com/jessebldr/clear-claude) with two independent plugins: Clear Partner (`clear-partner@clear-claude`), an output style that makes Claude answer first and stay concise without dropping substance, and Clear UI (`clear-ui@clear-claude`), a status bar. The plugin `clear-partner` was named `clear-claude` before marketplace 0.4.0.

This file is an index. Every fact lives in exactly one of the documents below; nothing is restated here.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what it is, the install commands, what changes on the user's machine, how to update and remove it
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): repository rules for coding agents — layout, commands, invariants, where each fact lives
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): what each release changes for a user
